scheme_name: State Agriculture Scholarship for B.Sc. & M.Sc. Agriculture
other_conditions: Applicant must be from an institution with a valid AISHE/UDISE code.
Students who have failed in their last examination (repeaters) are not eligible.
Applicants must not be a beneficiary of any other scholarship scheme.
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹700 per month for B.Sc. Agriculture and ₹900 per month for M.Sc. Agriculture, along with annual book grants and reimbursements.
